notes: Noise: needs the roof cooling plant in an enclosed plant room. On the roof, even with low-noise chillers and a solid screen, it would give about 69 dBA at 275 1ST AVE E (I-3, activity zone), 28 m away, over the 65 dBA night limit (Noise Control By-law 6555 s. 2.3(b)(ii)). The plant room is the next measure, and the least that passes; its floor comes out of the building (register arch_nz_nswDcNoise).

Generator test (Noise By-law 6555 s. 4.1(c)): one set at a time is about 75.7 dB(A) at 9.1 m (the nearest lot line), within the 80 dB(A) test limit (78 dB(A) at 7 m, Kohler G6-154, maker claim; free field, our arithmetic). Sets tested together would be louder. Running in a power cut as emergency works (s. 4.3(c)): our reading (?).

Noise: needs a plant room: solid walls, roof RW 47 or better, gaps sealed, louvres of at least 6–27 dB by band (NSW 2021 Table 4-5): −25 dB (arch_nz_nswDcNoise). Without it: about 73–77 dBA (quieter–standard unit rating) at the point of reception beside 275 1ST AVE E (I-3, activity zone), 23 m away; limit 65 dBA at night (Noise Control By-law 6555 s. 2.3(b)(ii)).

loadingNeed.basis: 2 truck loading bays: 2 for the data centre's 1,917 m² of floor. Each class of use is counted separately and the counts added (Parking By-law s. 5.1, Multi-Use Developments). The by-law calls this size Class B, its mid-size bay: 10.2 × 3.4 m with 3.8 m clearance (Class C is the 23.1 m bay for the largest trucks). The data centre uses row 5.2.5: the by-law does not name data centres, but the City classes them as a Transportation and Storage use (RTS 19744), which row 5.2.5 lists. Each bay is reached by a 6.1 m aisle (s. 5.4.1).

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer. Basis unit: Vertiv Liebert AFC FIZ135, 12.14 × 2.36 m, 2.90 m high, 1,489 kW at 35 °C ambient, 27.8 → 18.9 °C fluid, 30% glycol, with oversized free-cooling coils (Vertiv SL-71060 R09/24, "Preliminary data"; manufacturer claim). genLines: 2 generator sets of about 2 MW carry 3.9 MW; with spares, 3. Placed: 0 on the roof, 3 in the yard.
Each about 13.493 × 3.488 m, 4.777 m high; 1.5 m from the building, 2 m between sets (1 m clear all round, CSA C282 6.5.1.1; register arch_csa_c282).

Fuel in each set's sub-base tank: about 6100 L. In the yard: 3 m from the property line and 1.5 m from the building (CSA B139.1.0 Table 2; register arch_csa_b139). On a roof: at most 1,250 L a tank and 2,500 L a supply line (B139.1.1 6.5.3). FM 5-32 (insurer guidance, not law): not on the roof or in a basement.

base.rule: Building height is measured from the base surface: the surface joining the official established building grades at all corners of the site, from the City Engineer; existing grades only where those cannot be obtained or the Director of Planning finds them incompatible (Zoning and Development By-law s. 2, 'Base Surface' p. 4, 'Building Height' p. 5). The official grades are not on file, so the lot grade shown is not the base (?).

noiseRoom.block: Noise: the cooling plant (roof) would give about 69 dBA (low-noise units: one rating) at the point of reception beside 275 1ST AVE E (I-3, activity zone), 28 m away, even with low-noise chillers (Trane RTAF 280 LN, maker claim) + a 4.9 m solid screen (roof; NSW 2021, −8 dB): over the 65 dBA night limit with the quieter rating (Noise Control By-law 6555 s. 2.3(b)(ii); the plant runs 24 h, so the night limit governs). No modelled option brings it under. To bring it under: a smaller size (fewer units); the cooling plant in the yard or split, if that moves it further from this lot; liquid cooling …
